steps.body:
\[\overrightarrow{CD}=\frac32(2\mathbf a+2\mathbf b)=3\mathbf a+3\mathbf b.\]

Use the stated relationship between CD and AC.
steps.title: Part (a) | Step 1

steps.body:
\[\overrightarrow{OD}=\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{AC}+\overrightarrow{CD}=3\mathbf a+(2\mathbf a+2\mathbf b)+(3\mathbf a+3\mathbf b)=8\mathbf a+5\mathbf b.\]

Add consecutive vectors along the route O-A-C-D.
steps.title: Part (a) | Step 2

steps.body:
\[\overrightarrow{OC}=3\mathbf a+(2\mathbf a+2\mathbf b)=5\mathbf a+2\mathbf b,\qquad\overrightarrow{BC}=5\mathbf a-2\mathbf b.\]

Use OC=OA+AC and BC=OC-OB.
steps.title: Part (b) | Step 1

steps.body:
Write \(\overrightarrow{OP}=t\overrightarrow{OD}=8t\mathbf a+5t\mathbf b\). Also, because P lies on BC, \[\overrightarrow{OP}=\overrightarrow{OB}+s\overrightarrow{BC}=5s\mathbf a+(4-2s)\mathbf b.\]

Use one scalar parameter on each of the two intersecting lines.
steps.title: Part (b) | Step 2

steps.body:
\[8t=5s,\qquad5t=4-2s,\qquad s=\frac85t.\]

Equate the coefficients of the two nonparallel base vectors.
steps.title: Part (b) | Step 3

steps.body:
\[5t=4-\frac{16}{5}t\quad\Longrightarrow\quad41t=20\quad\Longrightarrow\quad t=\frac{20}{41}.\]

Substitute the first relation into the second and solve.
steps.title: Part (b) | Step 4

steps.body:
\[OP:PD=t:(1-t)=\frac{20}{41}:\frac{21}{41}=20:21.\]

OD is divided into the fractions t and 1-t at P.
steps.title: Part (b) | Step 5

steps.body:
\[27=3^3,\qquad9=3^2,\qquad\frac{6^x}{2^x}=\left(\frac62\right)^x=3^x.\]

Write both sides in a common base.
steps.title: Solution | Step 1

steps.body:
\[\frac{27^x\times3^{n+6}}{9^{4-n}}=3^{3x+n+6-2(4-n)}=3^{3x+3n-2}.\]

Multiply powers by adding indices and divide powers by subtracting indices.
steps.title: Solution | Step 2

steps.body:
\[3^{3x+3n-2}=3^x\quad\Longrightarrow\quad3x+3n-2=x.\]

The base-3 exponential is one-to-one, so equal powers have equal indices.
steps.title: Solution | Step 3

steps.body:
\[2x=2-3n\quad\Longrightarrow\quad x=1-\frac{3n}{2}.\]

Collect the x terms and divide by 2.
steps.title: Solution | Step 4
